meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Adds a native DeepSeek Chat mode beside Agent mode, with a shared Chat | Agent switch. It supports official DeepSeek chat-export ZIP import, long-term memory (automatic extraction, cross-chat retrieval, memory summary, Ask or Update, and importing memories from other AI tools), deep thinking with effort levels, web search with citations, URL reading, file and image upload, model selection, persistent history, folders, pin/archive, history search, message editing, answer versions, and Chat to Agent handoff. Imported chats can optionally be analyzed for long-term memory; memories stay on this machine. Chat uses the signed-in DeepSeek account or a DeepSeek API key stored in the DSH credential store; the key never reaches the browser. Web search, document parsing, and memory extraction use DeepSeek services and may incur usage charges. Agent mode and existing DSH capabilities are unchanged.
